# qweek-ui Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** A Next.js app where pasting a URL produces a self-contained Tailwind-CDN HTML clone of that homepage in under 5 minutes, rendered progressively into a live iframe, generated by Claude via the `claude` CLI on the user's Max subscription.

**Architecture:** Next.js App Router app. A single SSE route (`GET /api/clone/stream?url=`) runs the pipeline: `capture` (Playwright screenshot tiles) → `scrape` (real asset URLs/text/tokens) → `prompt` (build instruction with output markers) → `generate` (spawn `claude` CLI, parse the streamed JSON, emit `stage`/`thought`/`head`/`section`/`done`/`error` events). The client renders completed sections into an iframe as they arrive.

**Tech Stack:** Next.js (App Router, Node runtime), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS (app's own UI), Playwright (chromium), the `claude` CLI, Vitest (unit tests). Package manager: **bun**.

## Global Constraints

- Output of a clone is **ONE self-contained `.html` file** using **Tailwind via CDN** (`<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>`). No build step in the generated file.
- Generation model is a single swappable constant `GEN_MODEL = "claude-opus-4-8"` in `lib/generate.ts`.
- The `claude` CLI is invoked with: `--print --output-format stream-json --input-format stream-json --include-partial-messages --verbose --model <GEN_MODEL> --permission-mode bypassPermissions`.
- Generated HTML must use the model's **delimited output markers**: exactly one `<!--HEAD-->…<!--/HEAD-->` block, then ordered `<!--SECTION:name-->…<!--/SECTION-->` blocks, and nothing else outside markers.
- SSE event names and payloads are fixed: `stage {stage}`, `thought {text}`, `head {html}`, `section {name, html}`, `done {fullHtml}`, `error {message}`.
- v1 scope: homepage only, desktop width 1440px. No mobile, no multi-page, no editor, no DB, no auth.
- All API routes that use Playwright / child_process set `export const runtime = "nodejs"` and `export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"`.
- Use **bun** for all package/install/run commands.

```ts
export type Stage = "capturing" | "scraping" | "generating";

export interface ScrapeResult {
  url: string;
  title: string;
  images: { src: string; alt: string }[];
  backgroundImages: string[];
  logo: string | null;
  text: string;
  colors: string[];
  fonts: string[];
}

export interface CaptureResult {
  tiles: string[];
  pageHeight: number;
}

export type CloneEvent =
  | { type: "stage"; stage: Stage }
  | { type: "thought"; text: string }
  | { type: "head"; html: string }
  | { type: "section"; name: string; html: string }
  | { type: "done"; fullHtml: string }
  | { type: "error"; message: string };

export function sseLine(e: CloneEvent): string {
  return `data: ${JSON.stringify(e)}\n\n`;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the implementation**

Create `src/lib/url.ts`:

```ts
export function normalizeUrl(input: string): string {
  const trimmed = (input ?? "").trim();
  if (!trimmed) throw new Error("Invalid URL");
  const withScheme = /^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:\/\//.test(trimmed)
    ? trimmed
    : `https://${trimmed}`;
  let parsed: URL;
  try {
    parsed = new URL(withScheme);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("Invalid URL");
  }
  if (parsed.protocol !== "http:" && parsed.protocol !== "https:") {
    throw new Error("Invalid URL");
  }
  return parsed.toString();
}
```

### Task 4: Stream marker parser (HEAD / SECTION extraction)

This is the core of progressive preview. Pure function, fully TDD'd.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/parser.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/parser.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `class MarkerParser` with:
  - `push(textChunk: string): CloneEvent[]` — feed accumulated streamed text deltas; returns any newly-completed `head` / `section` events (each emitted exactly once).
  - `assemble(): string` — returns the full file = head + all sections joined with `\n`.
- Consumes: `CloneEvent` from `src/lib/types.ts`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests**

Create `src/lib/parser.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { MarkerParser } from "./parser";

describe("MarkerParser", () => {
  it("emits head once when the HEAD block closes", () => {
    const p = new MarkerParser();
    expect(p.push("<!--HEAD-->abc")).toEqual([]);
    const events = p.push("def<!--/HEAD-->");
    expect(events).toEqual([{ type: "head", html: "abcdef" }]);
  });

  it("emits a section with its name", () => {
    const p = new MarkerParser();
    const events = p.push("<!--SECTION:hero--><div>hi</div><!--/SECTION-->");
    expect(events).toEqual([{ type: "section", name: "hero", html: "<div>hi</div>" }]);
  });

  it("emits multiple blocks across chunk boundaries, each once", () => {
    const p = new MarkerParser();
    let all: any[] = [];
    all = all.concat(p.push("<!--HEAD-->H<!--/HEAD--><!--SECT"));
    all = all.concat(p.push("ION:a-->A<!--/SECTION--><!--SECTION:b-->B"));
    all = all.concat(p.push("<!--/SECTION-->"));
    expect(all).toEqual([
      { type: "head", html: "H" },
      { type: "section", name: "a", html: "A" },
      { type: "section", name: "b", html: "B" },
    ]);
  });

  it("assembles the full file from head + sections", () => {
    const p = new MarkerParser();
    p.push("<!--HEAD-->H<!--/HEAD--><!--SECTION:a-->A<!--/SECTION-->");
    expect(p.assemble()).toBe("H\nA");
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the implementation**

Create `src/lib/parser.ts`:

```ts
import type { CloneEvent } from "./types";

export class MarkerParser {
  private buffer = "";
  private head: string | null = null;
  private sections: { name: string; html: string }[] = [];

  push(textChunk: string): CloneEvent[] {
    this.buffer += textChunk;
    const events: CloneEvent[] = [];
    let madeProgress = true;
    while (madeProgress) {
      madeProgress = false;

      if (this.head === null) {
        const m = /<!--HEAD-->([\s\S]*?)<!--\/HEAD-->/.exec(this.buffer);
        if (m) {
          this.head = m[1].trim();
          events.push({ type: "head", html: this.head });
          this.buffer = this.buffer.slice(m.index + m[0].length);
          madeProgress = true;
          continue;
        }
      }

      const s = /<!--SECTION:([\s\S]*?)-->([\s\S]*?)<!--\/SECTION-->/.exec(this.buffer);
      if (s) {
        const name = s[1].trim();
        const html = s[2].trim();
        this.sections.push({ name, html });
        events.push({ type: "section", name, html });
        this.buffer = this.buffer.slice(s.index + s[0].length);
        madeProgress = true;
      }
    }
    return events;
  }

  assemble(): string {
    const parts: string[] = [];
    if (this.head !== null) parts.push(this.head);
    for (const sec of this.sections) parts.push(sec.html);
    return parts.join("\n");
  }
}
```

```ts
import type { ScrapeResult } from "./types";

export function buildPrompt(scrape: ScrapeResult): string {
  const assets = JSON.stringify(
    {
      logo: scrape.logo,
      images: scrape.images,
      backgroundImages: scrape.backgroundImages,
      colors: scrape.colors,
      fonts: scrape.fonts,
    },
    null,
    2
  );

  return `You are an expert front-end engineer. Clone the homepage shown in the attached screenshots as faithfully as possible (pixel-accurate desktop layout at 1440px width).

SOURCE URL: ${scrape.url}
PAGE TITLE: ${scrape.title}

You are given full-page screenshots (in order, top to bottom) AND the page's real scraped assets and text below. Use the REAL asset URLs and REAL text — do not invent placeholders or lorem ipsum.

REAL ASSETS (JSON):
${assets}

VISIBLE TEXT (use exact copy where it matches the screenshots):
"""
${scrape.text.slice(0, 8000)}
"""

OUTPUT RULES (CRITICAL — follow exactly):
1. Output ONE self-contained HTML document and NOTHING else (no markdown fences, no commentary).
2. Load Tailwind via CDN: <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>. Add any custom theme via an inline tailwind.config script and any custom CSS via a <style> tag, all inside the HEAD block.
3. Structure the output with these EXACT delimiter markers and nothing outside them:
   <!--HEAD-->
   ...everything that belongs in <head>: meta, Tailwind CDN <script>, Google Font <link>s, tailwind.config script, <style>...
   <!--/HEAD-->
   <!--SECTION:header-->...<!--/SECTION-->
   <!--SECTION:hero-->...<!--/SECTION-->
   <!--SECTION:...-->...<!--/SECTION-->
   (one SECTION block per visual section, in top-to-bottom document order; name each section in lowercase-kebab)
4. Each SECTION block contains only the markup for that section (e.g. a <section>, <header>, or <footer> element). Do NOT include <html>, <head>, or <body> tags inside sections.
5. Use the real image URLs from the assets JSON for <img> src and CSS background-image. Match colors, fonts, spacing, and layout to the screenshots.
6. Make it look complete and polished. Desktop only.

Begin now with <!--HEAD-->.`;
}
```

### Task 6: Capture + scrape (Playwright)

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/capture.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces:
  - `async function captureAndScrape(url: string, outDir: string): Promise<{ capture: CaptureResult; scrape: ScrapeResult }>`
- Consumes: `CaptureResult`, `ScrapeResult` from `src/lib/types.ts`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the implementation**

Create `src/lib/capture.ts`:

```ts
import { chromium } from "playwright";
import { promises as fs } from "fs";
import path from "path";
import type { CaptureResult, ScrapeResult } from "./types";

const TILE_HEIGHT = 1400;
const MAX_TILES = 12;

export async function captureAndScrape(
  url: string,
  outDir: string
): Promise<{ capture: CaptureResult; scrape: ScrapeResult }> {
  await fs.mkdir(outDir, { recursive: true });
  const browser = await chromium.launch();
  try {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } });
    await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: "networkidle", timeout: 60000 });

    // Trigger lazy-loading: scroll to bottom in steps, then back to top.
    await page.evaluate(async () => {
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        let y = 0;
        const step = () => {
          window.scrollBy(0, 800);
          y += 800;
          if (y < document.body.scrollHeight) setTimeout(step, 100);
          else resolve();
        };
        step();
      });
    });
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
    await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);

    // Full-page screenshot, then slice into tiles.
    const fullPath = path.join(outDir, "full.png");
    await page.screenshot({ path: fullPath, fullPage: true });
    const pageHeight = await page.evaluate(() => document.body.scrollHeight);

    const { default: sharpModule } = await import("playwright").then(() => ({ default: null }));
    // Slice using clip screenshots (no extra dep): re-screenshot each tile region.
    const tiles: string[] = [];
    const tileCount = Math.min(MAX_TILES, Math.ceil(pageHeight / TILE_HEIGHT));
    for (let i = 0; i < tileCount; i++) {
      const y = i * TILE_HEIGHT;
      const h = Math.min(TILE_HEIGHT, pageHeight - y);
      if (h <= 0) break;
      const tilePath = path.join(outDir, `tile-${i}.png`);
      await page.screenshot({
        path: tilePath,
        clip: { x: 0, y, width: 1440, height: h },
      });
      tiles.push(tilePath);
    }

    // Scrape assets + text + tokens in the page context.
    const scrapeData = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const abs = (u: string) => {
        try { return new URL(u, location.href).href; } catch { return u; }
      };
      const images = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("img"))
        .map((img) => ({ src: abs(img.currentSrc || img.src || ""), alt: img.alt || "" }))
        .filter((i) => i.src && !i.src.startsWith("data:"));
      const backgroundImages: string[] = [];
      for (const el of Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("*")).slice(0, 4000)) {
        const bg = getComputedStyle(el as Element).backgroundImage;
        const m = /url\(["']?(.*?)["']?\)/.exec(bg);
        if (m && m[1] && !m[1].startsWith("data:")) backgroundImages.push(abs(m[1]));
      }
      const logoEl =
        document.querySelector("header img, [class*='logo'] img, a[href='/'] img") ||
        document.querySelector("img");
      const colorCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
      const fontSet = new Set<string>();
      for (const el of Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("*")).slice(0, 4000)) {
        const cs = getComputedStyle(el as Element);
        colorCounts[cs.color] = (colorCounts[cs.color] || 0) + 1;
        if (cs.backgroundColor && cs.backgroundColor !== "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)")
          colorCounts[cs.backgroundColor] = (colorCounts[cs.backgroundColor] || 0) + 1;
        if (cs.fontFamily) fontSet.add(cs.fontFamily.split(",")[0].replace(/["']/g, "").trim());
      }
      const colors = Object.entries(colorCounts)
        .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 12).map(([c]) => c);
      return {
        title: document.title,
        images: images.slice(0, 120),
        backgroundImages: Array.from(new Set(backgroundImages)).slice(0, 60),
        logo: logoEl ? abs((logoEl as HTMLImageElement).src) : null,
        text: (document.body.innerText || "").replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n"),
        colors,
        fonts: Array.from(fontSet).slice(0, 12),
      };
    });

    const scrape: ScrapeResult = { url, ...scrapeData };
    return { capture: { tiles, pageHeight }, scrape };
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
  }
}
```

> Note: the `sharpModule` line above is dead scaffolding from an earlier idea — delete it; tiling is done with Playwright `clip` screenshots, no `sharp` dependency.

Remove that line so the file has no unused import. Final `capture.ts` must not reference `sharpModule`.

### Task 7: Generate module (spawn claude CLI, parse stream)

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/generate.ts`
- Create: `scripts/try-generate.ts` (manual verification harness)

**Interfaces:**
- Produces:
  - `const GEN_MODEL = "claude-opus-4-8"`
  - `async function* generate(prompt: string, tilePaths: string[]): AsyncGenerator<CloneEvent>` — spawns the CLI, yields `thought` (from any thinking deltas), `head`, `section`, and finally `done` (full assembled file). Throws → caller emits `error`.
- Consumes: `MarkerParser` (Task 4), `CloneEvent` (Task 2).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the implementation**

Create `src/lib/generate.ts`:

```ts
import { spawn } from "child_process";
import { promises as fs } from "fs";
import type { CloneEvent } from "./types";
import { MarkerParser } from "./parser";

export const GEN_MODEL = "claude-opus-4-8";

async function fileToBase64(p: string): Promise<string> {
  const buf = await fs.readFile(p);
  return buf.toString("base64");
}

export async function* generate(
  prompt: string,
  tilePaths: string[]
): AsyncGenerator<CloneEvent> {
  // Build the stream-json user message: prompt text + screenshot tiles as image blocks.
  const content: any[] = [{ type: "text", text: prompt }];
  for (const p of tilePaths) {
    content.push({
      type: "image",
      source: { type: "base64", media_type: "image/png", data: await fileToBase64(p) },
    });
  }
  const userMessage = JSON.stringify({
    type: "user",
    message: { role: "user", content },
  });

  const child = spawn(
    "claude",
    [
      "--print",
      "--output-format", "stream-json",
      "--input-format", "stream-json",
      "--include-partial-messages",
      "--verbose",
      "--model", GEN_MODEL,
      "--permission-mode", "bypassPermissions",
    ],
    { stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"] }
  );

  child.stdin.write(userMessage + "\n");
  child.stdin.end();

  const parser = new MarkerParser();
  const queue: CloneEvent[] = [];
  let resolveWait: (() => void) | null = null;
  let done = false;
  let stderr = "";
  let exitErr: Error | null = null;

  const wake = () => { if (resolveWait) { resolveWait(); resolveWait = null; } };

  let lineBuf = "";
  const handleLine = (line: string) => {
    const trimmed = line.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return;
    let obj: any;
    try { obj = JSON.parse(trimmed); } catch { return; }

    // Extract text + thinking deltas defensively across possible shapes.
    const pushText = (t: string) => { for (const e of parser.push(t)) queue.push(e); };

    if (obj.type === "stream_event" && obj.event) {
      const ev = obj.event;
      if (ev.type === "content_block_delta" && ev.delta) {
        if (ev.delta.type === "text_delta" && ev.delta.text) pushText(ev.delta.text);
        if (ev.delta.type === "thinking_delta" && ev.delta.thinking)
          queue.push({ type: "thought", text: ev.delta.thinking });
      }
    } else if (obj.type === "assistant" && obj.message?.content) {
      for (const block of obj.message.content) {
        if (block.type === "text" && block.text) pushText(block.text);
        if (block.type === "thinking" && block.thinking)
          queue.push({ type: "thought", text: block.thinking });
      }
    }
    wake();
  };

  child.stdout.on("data", (d: Buffer) => {
    lineBuf += d.toString();
    let idx;
    while ((idx = lineBuf.indexOf("\n")) >= 0) {
      handleLine(lineBuf.slice(0, idx));
      lineBuf = lineBuf.slice(idx + 1);
    }
  });
  child.stderr.on("data", (d: Buffer) => { stderr += d.toString(); });
  child.on("error", (e) => { exitErr = e; done = true; wake(); });
  child.on("close", (code) => {
    if (lineBuf.trim()) handleLine(lineBuf);
    if (code !== 0 && code !== null) exitErr = new Error(`claude exited ${code}: ${stderr.slice(0, 500)}`);
    done = true;
    wake();
  });

  while (true) {
    if (queue.length) { yield queue.shift()!; continue; }
    if (done) break;
    await new Promise<void>((res) => { resolveWait = res; });
  }
  if (exitErr) throw exitErr;
  yield { type: "done", fullHtml: wrapHtml(parser.assemble()) };
}

function wrapHtml(body: string): string {
  // If the model already emitted a HEAD block, parser.assemble() begins with head content.
  // Wrap head + sections into a valid document.
  const headMatch = /<\s*meta|<\s*script|<\s*style|<\s*link|<\s*title/i.test(body);
  if (!headMatch) {
    return `<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script></head><body>${body}</body></html>`;
  }
  // Heuristic: first head-ish content up to first top-level section element becomes <head>.
  return `<!doctype html><html><head>${extractHead(body)}</head><body>${extractBody(body)}</body></html>`;
}

// The parser joins head first then sections. We re-split on the first section-like element.
function extractHead(body: string): string {
  const idx = body.search(/<(section|header|footer|main|div)[\s>]/i);
  return idx > 0 ? body.slice(0, idx) : body;
}
function extractBody(body: string): string {
  const idx = body.search(/<(section|header|footer|main|div)[\s>]/i);
  return idx > 0 ? body.slice(idx) : "";
}
```

> Implementation note: `parser.assemble()` joins the HEAD content and section HTML with `\n`. `wrapHtml` reconstitutes a valid document by treating the leading head-ish markup as `<head>` and the rest as `<body>`. The client builds its live preview the same way (head from the `head` event, sections appended) — see Task 9.

### Task 8: SSE pipeline route

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/api/clone/stream/route.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `normalizeUrl` (Task 3), `captureAndScrape` (Task 6), `buildPrompt` (Task 5), `generate` (Task 7), `sseLine`/types (Task 2).
- Produces: `GET` handler streaming `text/event-stream`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the route**

Create `src/app/api/clone/stream/route.ts`:

```ts
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import os from "os";
import path from "path";
import { promises as fs } from "fs";
import { normalizeUrl } from "@/lib/url";
import { captureAndScrape } from "@/lib/capture";
import { buildPrompt } from "@/lib/prompt";
import { generate } from "@/lib/generate";
import { sseLine, type CloneEvent } from "@/lib/types";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const raw = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("url") ?? "";
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();

  const stream = new ReadableStream({
    async start(controller) {
      const send = (e: CloneEvent) => controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(sseLine(e)));
      const jobDir = path.join(os.tmpdir(), "qweek-ui", `${Date.now()}`);
      try {
        const url = normalizeUrl(raw);
        send({ type: "stage", stage: "capturing" });
        const { capture, scrape } = await captureAndScrape(url, jobDir);
        send({ type: "stage", stage: "scraping" });
        const prompt = buildPrompt(scrape);
        send({ type: "stage", stage: "generating" });
        for await (const e of generate(prompt, capture.tiles)) {
          send(e);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        send({ type: "error", message: err?.message ?? "Unknown error" });
      } finally {
        controller.close();
        fs.rm(jobDir, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {});
      }
    },
  });

  return new Response(stream, {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "text/event-stream",
      "Cache-Control": "no-cache, no-transform",
      Connection: "keep-alive",
    },
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the client component**

Create `src/app/clone-view.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";
import { useRef, useState } from "react";

type SectionItem = { name: string; html: string };

export default function CloneView() {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("");
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<string>("");
  const [thoughts, setThoughts] = useState<string>("");
  const [head, setHead] = useState<string>("");
  const [sections, setSections] = useState<SectionItem[]>([]);
  const [fullHtml, setFullHtml] = useState<string>("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>("");
  const [showCode, setShowCode] = useState(false);
  const esRef = useRef<EventSource | null>(null);

  const srcDoc =
    head || sections.length
      ? `<!doctype html><html><head>${head}</head><body>${sections
          .map((s) => s.html)
          .join("\n")}</body></html>`
      : "";

  function start() {
    if (!url.trim() || running) return;
    setRunning(true);
    setError("");
    setStage("starting");
    setThoughts("");
    setHead("");
    setSections([]);
    setFullHtml("");
    const es = new EventSource(`/api/clone/stream?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`);
    esRef.current = es;
    es.onmessage = (m) => {
      const e = JSON.parse(m.data);
      if (e.type === "stage") setStage(e.stage);
      else if (e.type === "thought") setThoughts((t) => t + e.text);
      else if (e.type === "head") setHead(e.html);
      else if (e.type === "section") setSections((s) => [...s, { name: e.name, html: e.html }]);
      else if (e.type === "done") {
        setFullHtml(e.fullHtml);
        setRunning(false);
        es.close();
      } else if (e.type === "error") {
        setError(e.message);
        setRunning(false);
        es.close();
      }
    };
    es.onerror = () => {
      if (running) setError("Connection lost");
      setRunning(false);
      es.close();
    };
  }

  function download() {
    const blob = new Blob([fullHtml], { type: "text/html" });
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = "clone.html";
    a.click();
  }
  function openTab() {
    const w = window.open();
    if (w) { w.document.open(); w.document.write(fullHtml); w.document.close(); }
  }

  const started = running || !!srcDoc || !!error;

  if (!started) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-6 p-6">
        <h1 className="text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight">Clone a website.</h1>
        <p className="text-gray-500">Paste any URL. Get an editable HTML copy in minutes.</p>
        <div className="flex w-full max-w-2xl gap-2">
          <input
            className="flex-1 rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 outline-none"
            placeholder="https://themomsco.com"
            value={url}
            onChange={(e) => setUrl(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && start()}
          />
          <button onClick={start} className="rounded-xl bg-black px-6 py-3 text-white">
            Clone
          </button>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="grid h-screen grid-cols-[320px_1fr]">
      <aside className="overflow-y-auto border-r p-4 text-sm">
        <div className="mb-2 font-semibold">{url}</div>
        <div className="mb-4 text-gray-500">Stage: {running ? stage : error ? "error" : "done"}</div>
        {error && <div className="mb-4 rounded bg-red-50 p-2 text-red-600">{error}</div>}
        <div className="mb-2 font-medium">Sections</div>
        <ul className="mb-4 space-y-1">
          {sections.map((s, i) => (
            <li key={i} className="text-green-700">✓ {s.name}</li>
          ))}
          {running && <li className="text-gray-400">…generating</li>}
        </ul>
        {thoughts && (
          <>
            <div className="mb-1 font-medium">Thought Process</div>
            <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-xs text-gray-500">{thoughts}</pre>
          </>
        )}
        {fullHtml && (
          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-2">
            <button onClick={() => setShowCode((v) => !v)} className="rounded border px-3 py-2">
              {showCode ? "Hide" : "View"} code
            </button>
            <button onClick={() => navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullHtml)} className="rounded border px-3 py-2">
              Copy code
            </button>
            <button onClick={download} className="rounded border px-3 py-2">Download .html</button>
            <button onClick={openTab} className="rounded border px-3 py-2">Open in new tab</button>
          </div>
        )}
      </aside>
      <section className="overflow-hidden bg-gray-100">
        {showCode ? (
          <pre className="h-full overflow-auto bg-gray-900 p-4 text-xs text-gray-100">{fullHtml}</pre>
        ) : (
          <iframe title="preview" className="h-full w-full bg-white" srcDoc={srcDoc} />
        )}
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Write the README**

Create `README.md`:

```markdown
# qweek-ui

Paste a URL → get a self-contained Tailwind-CDN HTML clone of its homepage, rendered live as it generates. Backend generation runs on your Claude Max subscription via the `claude` CLI (no API key).

## Prerequisites
- Bun, Node 18+
- `claude` CLI installed and logged in (Max subscription)
- `bunx playwright install chromium` (one-time)

## Run
\`\`\`bash
bun install
bun run dev
\`\`\`
Open the printed URL, paste a website URL, click Clone.

## How it works
1. Playwright captures full-page screenshot tiles + scrapes real assets/text (`src/lib/capture.ts`).
2. A prompt with the screenshots and real assets is sent to `claude` (`src/lib/generate.ts`), which streams back one HTML file using `<!--HEAD-->` / `<!--SECTION:name-->` markers.
3. The SSE route (`src/app/api/clone/stream`) forwards events; the client renders completed sections progressively into an iframe.

## Limits (v1)
Homepage only, desktop only. No mobile, multi-page, or in-place editing yet.
```
